Another Epidemic or Pandemic??

The outbreak of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in China is concerning, especially with the symptoms mimicking both flu and COVID-19, which can understandably cause alarm.

Source : @BRICSinfo https://t.co/gNcSJ

nodes.author: InfoRadar
nodes.text: According to reports, this virus can lead to significant respiratory issues, particularly in children and vulnerable populations, which might explain the overcrowding in hospitals.

nodes.author: InfoRadar
nodes.text: Let's hope for a swift containment and that our global health systems are better prepared this time. Stay safe, everyone!

nodes.author: InfoRadar
nodes.text: It’s important to note that while the situation is serious, health authorities have indicated that it doesn't signal a new global health crisis yet. It's crucial for everyone to stay informed, follow health guidelines, & take preventive measures avoiding close contact when sick.
